name: Coupa Expense Reconciliation
output_format: session-updates-<chat-name>.md deltas (Claude Enterprise can't edit project files in place); structured summaries and variance flags

changes: Initial skill packaging for Claude Enterprise
Converted from a technical integration spec (JSON I/O schemas) into a conversational workflow, matching the format of the other three skills
Added session-updates.md protocol: writes now append dated deltas to a session artifact instead of rewriting inventory.md, since CE can't edit project files in place
Added a Querying Coupa section with live-verified coupa_graphql patterns, replacing improvised query syntax that was failing against the connector
Documented confirmed failures: Relay-style first/filters/edges, dotted nested-field filters, and ~ / [c]= wildcard operators all error rather than returning empty
Documented that the query filter is exact-match and case-insensitive, and that no-argument queries default to ascending id with a ~50-record cut, making recent reports appear missing
Added a data-boundary rule: unfiltered expenseReports queries return cross-organization expense data and must never be logged or written to session-updates.md
Added field-parsing rules (comma-formatted total, non-padded amount, ISO timestamp expenseDate, signed expiring artifact URLs, expenseArtifacts not attachments)
Rewrote the periodic audit to page with orderBy/limit/offset and filter dates client-side, since range operators error on this connector
Added music mode: reconcile sheet-music purchases against repertoire.md REP-### rows, supporting handoff from music-purchase
Bundled the verified API guide under references/ so the package stays self-contained

retrieval_pattern: Read from inventory.md (landed cost, purchase date, supplier, service records) and repertoire.md (REP-###, title, vendor, price), and from Coupa (expense reports, expense lines, receipt artifacts) via coupa_graphql; writes via session-updates.md
description: Reconcile instrument, repair, and sheet-music expenses against Coupa expense reports and invoices — searching Coupa with verified query patterns, matching receipt line items to inventory or repertoire records, allocating shared shipping/tax across multi-item purchases, flagging cost variances, and recording the Coupa link for audit trail. Requires an active Coupa MCP connection.
